pkgmetadata.longdescription: Prebuilt binary of Rex, Superlogical's terminal multiplexer (one binary is both the server and the CLI). Installs OpenRC services for the shared server and the multi-account login server, the xterm-rex terminfo entry and, with the pam USE flag, the login server's PAM policy. Closed source: upstream publishes only the preview and snapshot channels, and the ebuild is pinned to one release commit. See the installed GUIDE.md for the re-pin procedure.

use.flag: Install the PAM policy for the Rex login server and depend on sys-libs/pam (the binary loads libpam at run time)
